method.movement_rule: Each class starts and ends each weekday at its assigned dorm. It returns to the dorm after every class whose next slot is empty; adjacent class slots are connected directly.
method.scope: New Campus and South Campus only
method.intercampus_handling: Counted as inter-campus movements but not assigned to a road because the supplied graph has no connector between campus boundaries.
method.coordinate_note: 科教南楼、科教北楼 have no named OSM footprint in the source map; their routes use the nearby named South Campus teaching-building proxy.
method.topology_note: Two source-road endpoints less than 30 m apart are joined as unrendered walking connectors, avoiding a false break in the extracted OSM topology.
method.field_rule: E001–E006 and E004–E016 are connected as supplied. E019 (the pedestrian overpass) is excluded from vehicle-route planning and vehicle heat.
method.user_route_rule: For trips using E418, the shared trunk of the original A006–J062 corridor, 50% stays on the base corridor and 50% uses the user-marked alternative U001.
